shared_elements: low-relief incised curvilinear motifs on stone
horizontal banding or registers of repeated design
justification: Both surfaces bear shallow incised/low-relief designs including a ringed circular disc and repeated curving forms arranged in roughly horizontal zones, but that is about as generic as decorated stone gets. A shows purely ornamental registers of rosettes, palmette-like foliate sprays and an interlaced scale/net border with no figure, whereas B is a monolithic anthropomorphic figure with a carved head and body bearing sparse symbolic marks (disc, paired ovals, girdle-like line) — different subject matter, different organisation, different conventions.
